Backend: Express API at `backend/index.js`; routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`. `RepositoryFactory` selects JSON-file or Mongo implementations. Menu routes use multer `upload.single("image")`.

Frontend: React app in `frontend/src/`; admin UI in `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (example: `adminhomes.jsx`). API client: `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, detects `FormData`, and unwraps response formats (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Always double check `credentials: 'include'`.

Auth is cookie-first: never rely on localStorage tokens in production; development fallback exists, but production expects httpOnly cookies. Images use local filesystem or Cloudinary; check `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`) and `backend/.env.examples`.

Read `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`, `backend/.env.examples`, `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, and `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`. For multer routes, frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData. Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.

Tests: `backend/src/__tests__` use `supertest`, app export from `backend/index.js`, and sometimes repository factories for fixtures. Prefer RepositoryFactory for controller/test data operations over direct file/db access. Add tests using `createTestAdmin`, `getAuthHeaders`, and `RepositoryFactory`.

When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.

Inspect root-level `package.json`, `backend/package.json`, and `frontend/package.json` for scripts. Commands: `cd backend && npm run dev`; `cd frontend && npm start`; `cd backend && npm test`. CI workflows: `.github/workflows/`, `backend-ci.yml`, `frontend-ci.yml`.
